meta_description:
4,430 likes, 43 comments - athleanx on October 13, 2026: "Don’t let the hardest part of the exercise prevent you from doing the exercise entirely. Bands are great for making resistance curves more favorable. Here, we know getting out of the hole on the dip is the most difficult part. It’s also the zone of greatest pec and front delt stretch so it shouldn’t necessarily be avoided - just accommodated. Using the bands as shown here will give you the assist at the bottom and remove the help at the top where you’re stronger. Even if you’re strong enough for weighted dips you can always have these on the ready for a drop set once you’ve fatigued with the weights - to keep training to and through failure. 

Remember, movement patterns have value. Specific exercises can be adapted to ensure you don’t miss out on the pattern. It’s how to train smart, train as hard as YOU can right now, and keep pushing ahead! Let the gains begin! #dips #bands #bandexercises #training #athleanx".
